messages: Ava (Marketing): hey team — first draft of the launch blog is up: https://docs.google.com/d/1abcXYZ (please use comment mode). Looking for quick passes on hero claim, benchmark callout, and webinar CTA. Jon (Product): reading now. quick note — the hero currently says \"40–60% lower token cost\". where does that number come from? need source or make it conservative. Ava (Marketing): sourced from Optimize report v3 (internal). I can add a footnote + link to the eval. prefer to keep it snappy though. thoughts on phrasing: \"Up to 50% lower per-token cost on retrieval workloads\"? Priya (Legal): please don’t use \"guarantee\" or \"always\". \"Up to 50%\" is ok but need the eval link + method blurb. also check the customer quote — authorization pending. Liam (Growth): webinar CTA: we should route registrants into two buckets — PLG trial vs. Sales-assisted demo. Can we capture that on the form? also want UTMs for the blog CTA. sample:```?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_content=webinar_cta``` Kai (Design): hero image ready in Figma (file linked in doc). Recommend a smaller headline so we can add a 1-line subhead with the latency stat. also suggest moving the webinar CTA above the fold as an inline button + secondary inline link. Ava (Marketing): good call. Jon — can you confirm latency stat? current draft says \"p50 < 80ms on short-context gen\". Jon (Product): that’s from our internal bench on Dedicated config A with seq len 128. fine if we say \"p50 ≈ 80ms on short-context configs (internal benchmark)\". add parenthetical. Priya (Legal): queueing quick-pass check. ETA 24h. put the eval procedure in the doc under \"bench appendix\" and avoid mentioning specific partners. Liam (Growth): I'll set up the HubSpot form mapping: blog -> webinar registrants assign lead source = blog_post, lifecycle_stage = marketing_engaged. @Ava which Salesforce campaign should these go to? Ava (Marketing): use Campaign: \"Q2 Dedicated Launch\". tag with content_variant=heroA (we'll A/B test). ops-bot: created webinar registration form (ID: wbf-20260505-01) and webhook to /integrations/hubspot/webhooks/wbf-20260505-01. First test event posted. Kai (Design): quick UX request — can we add a 2-line preview card image for social when we push OG tags? I added alt text in the doc. Liam (Growth): tracking snippet for team (copy into blog template): ```html Register ``` Ava (Marketing): thanks — next steps: 1) Jon update claims and add bench appendix link, 2) Priya legal quick-pass, 3) Liam wire hubspot & campaign mapping, 4) Kai finalize hero assets, 5) I'll lock copy once legal greenlights. aim to publish next Tue. please drop a final ack here when done. :thumbsup: Jon (Product): will update claims and add bench snippet today. Priya (Legal): noted — will review and comment in doc by EOD tomorrow. Liam (Growth): setting up campaign now, will post mapping here when complete. Kai (Design): final assets uploaded to the doc — marked as \"final\". Ava (Marketing): awesome. leaving this thread for final ack ping. :eyes:
